settings.name: Sunrise
settings.heading: A world worth exploring.
settings.text: Clothing inspired by extraordinary places, people, wildlife, cultures and ideas. Scroll, and spend a day with the sun.

settings.name: The canopy
settings.heading: Nature is art.
settings.text: Mist rising off the Amazon at first light. The colours of the canopy, made to be worn far from home.
settings.alt: Mist rising off a rainforest canopy at first light

settings.name: The woodland
settings.heading: Growth begins with the smallest things.
settings.text: Cream and mustard on moss. The heavyweight hoodie and the organic beanie, exactly as they were worn. Touch a pin to shop it.
settings.alt: Wearing the Basecamp Hoodie and a mustard beanie in a pine forest

settings.name: The terraces
settings.heading: Keep climbing.
settings.text: Shot among rice terraces and limestone peaks. Light layers for long days and longer walks.
settings.alt: Wearing the Everyday Tee in White among rice terraces
settings.alt_2: Standing among rice terraces below limestone peaks

settings.name: The ridge
settings.heading: Waiting for the light.
settings.text: The most moving beauty is often the most modest. A washed cap and a soft long sleeve, under a hard blue mountain sky.
settings.alt: Striped red and ochre ridges of a mountain under a cloudy sky
settings.print_alt: Wearing the Everyday Cap under a mountain sky

settings.name: Sunset
settings.heading: Leave the world better than you found it.
settings.text: All proceeds from Freemorrow support the work of Not For Sale, helping protect people and the planet by addressing human trafficking, modern-day slavery and ecocide.
